name: What is the difference between a bathroom remodel and a bathroom addition?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a bathroom remodel and a bathroom addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: A bathroom remodel typically updates an existing bathroom within its current footprint, focusing on aesthetic changes, fixture replacements, or minor layout adjustments. A bathroom addition, conversely, involves creating a new bathroom space where one didn't previously exist, either by extending the home or reconfiguring existing square footage. The latter involves more extensive construction, including new foundation, framing, and utility connections. Understanding your existing space and desired outcome helps determine the appropriate project type.
acceptedAnswer.description: A remodel updates an existing bathroom, while an addition creates a new bathroom space, requiring more extensive construction.
